title: 第1139章 各有天命第1138章 妾身愿助公子
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
李蒙摆了摆手。
“去吧。”
楼亭外的三人齐齐的拱手行礼。
随后转身向外别苑外走去。
离去时的三人脸上的神情各异。
丹药，法器，阵法，符箓，该怎么选？
吕家在丹药上经营有道。
已经收获了一番好名声。
姜家无法在丹药上与吕家争。
姜平夫妇在四选二之上左右为难。
沈清漪也好不到哪里去。
吕家产业对丹药，法器，阵法，符箓都有涉及。
只不过相比丹药。
其它的差了不少。
毕竟法器与阵法很难量产。
符箓虽然是消耗品。
但没有丹药那么的大众。
修士不能没有丹药。
符箓则可有可无。
符箓对修士而言只是多了一种保命手段。

有闲钱时可以买一张备用。
说不定哪一天就能救自己一命。
而且符箓的产量与品质都很难保证。
吕家也没有从公子那里得到多少符箓。
但要是把符箓让给姜家。
沈清漪又有些不甘心。
但要是因符箓而放弃法器与阵法。
沈清漪又有些犹豫。
三人心思各异的离开了别苑。
三人并没有急着商谈产业划分之事。
这件事不是小事。
必须把两家长老叫到一起商量。
有些话两家管事的人不好说。
content_en:
Li Meng waved his hand.
"Go ahead."
The three people outside the pavilion bowed in unison.
Then he turned around and walked outside the outer garden.
The three people leaving had different expressions on their faces.
How to choose between elixirs, magic weapons, formations, and talismans?
The Lu family is good at managing elixirs.
Already gained a good reputation.
The Jiang family cannot compete with the Lu family on elixirs.
Jiang Ping and his wife were in a dilemma over choosing two out of four.
Shen Qingyi was not much better.
The Lu family's industry involves elixirs, magic weapons, formations, and talismans.
It's just compared to pills.
The others are much worse.
After all, magic weapons and formations are difficult to mass-produce.
Although talismans are consumables.
But it is not as popular as elixirs.
A monk cannot live without elixirs.
The talisman is optional.
To the monks, the talisman is just one more way to save their lives.
You can buy one as a backup when you have spare money.
Maybe one day I can save my life.
Moreover, the output and quality of talismans are difficult to guarantee.
The Lu family didn't get many talismans from the young master.
But if the talisman is given to the Jiang family.
Shen Qingyi was a little unwilling again.
But if you give up the magic weapon and formation because of the talisman.
Shen Qingyi hesitated again.
The three people left the garden with different thoughts.
The three of them were not in a hurry to discuss the division of industry.
This matter is no small matter.
The elders of both families must be called together to discuss.
There are some things that are difficult for the people in charge of the two families to say.
